note: The attic shell (Oct 18 2026, TRIAL; changes/2026-10-18-attic-shell.json, DEVIATIONS 90). Read by tools/house/reconcile.py (attic_stair_spec -> spec/house_spec.json attic_stair.attic + boxes), tools/house/hifi_attic.py (Attic.glb) and SpecGreybox.Attic.cs. Spec frame: x toward the front, z along the house, y up from the upper floor.

floor_y.method: the attic floor sits on the upper ceilings' tops (2.55 under the whole attic; the parents' 2.65 slab is outside it: the attic starts past their hall wall); 7 cm of structure (hidden). 15 risers of 0.1747 at the controller's 0.20 step offset (2.5 cm margin, the main stair has 2.2): trial 1's 0.1907 risers stalled the adults (0.9 cm margin), and a 0.24 step offset let the bandit climb the den's 0.2 m plant pots (build Oct 18 10:05)

risers.method: 15 x 0.1747 with the proven 0.42 m run-in (a 1.85 m body's step-up probe clears the door head's casing) and a 0.165 going (46.6 deg) in the traced 2.735 m well

room_w.method: Marina p2 841/845 overhead: floor inside the knee walls 505 x 865 px (aspect 1.713), scaled to her on-screen 476 ft2 label: 5.08 x 8.70 m (outer wall tops 580 x 955 px: 5.18 x 8.53). Second ruler: the sofa bed's queen sleeper mattress (60 in) 147 px -> 5.21 m

room_l.method: LAYOUT from the user's poster (IMG_4295, framed isometric cutaway; user Oct 18: 'this appears to be right'): the attic runs the main block's length, the stair (balustrade round its well) near the high-z end with open floor past its head, the bed at the other end beside the chimney where the perpendicular hipped wing meets. Fitted to the house: high end over the den's end wall (z 19.92, the poster's floor past the stair head = the room over the den the user calls hidden), low end a partition just past the parents' hall wall, the parents' fireplace flue against it. Marina's 476 ft2 room (8.5 m) is now a check, not the size

knee_h.method: Marina p2 929: knee-wall top 360 px over the floor at the crib against it; the crib's side rail (0.90 m, standard) 260 px at the same wall -> 1.25 m

pitch_deg.method: the film-matched exterior shell's main roof (HomeAloneExterior.glb): area-weighted slope histogram over roof triangles, peak 40-42 deg (427 m2 at 40). Marina's rafters look 40-45 (oblique views only: not measured)

dormer_opening.method: film 9435 (from the treehouse, frontal): glazed pair 154 x 213 px beside the arched landing window's frame 365 px = our 1.25 m opening, +9% for the dormer standing ~1.5 m behind the rear wall: 0.56 x 0.80. Close-up set, human rulers: 10950 Kevin's head (0.20 m) 0.73 x 1.04; 11090 Marv's head 0.55 x 0.81, Harry's 0.64 x 0.95. Built at a stock 2'0" x 3'0" (0.61 x 0.91), inside every ruler's range

dormer_body_w.method: film 9435: cheek-to-cheek 308 px = 2.0 x the glazed pair -> 2.0 x 0.61 (+ the 14 cm walls rounded)

dormer_cornice_w.method: film 9435: cornice 374 px = 2.43 x the glazed pair

dormer_pitch_deg.method: film 9435: pediment rise 150 px over a 187 px half-width

dormer_sill_h.method: ASSUMED: film 10932-10936 (inside) show the sill at Kevin's knee with boards under it and 10950 shows the sill a short way above the shingles; no ruler

dormer_z.method: film 9435: the dormer is centred over the arched landing window (both at x 1500 px); our landing window's z_centre (spec/house_spec.ground.json)

end_lo_z.method: the partition stands just past the parents' hall wall (z 5.32-5.46; their 2.65 ceiling slab stays outside the attic), with the parents' fireplace flue rising against it at the rear knee wall (poster: the chimney beside the bed at this end)

end_hi_z.method: the den's end wall below (spec/geometry.json ground den), hipped end (poster)
